theorem physicalHeat_eq_profileCarrier (C : ℝ) (d : TailData) (y0 : ℝ)
    {p : PhysicalPoint} (ht : p.1 < 1) (hs : 0 < p.2.1) :
    physicalHeat C (1 + d.h) p =
      q d.h p ^ (-CoordinateAlgebra.A d.h) *
        profileCarrier C d y0 (xChart y0 (inner d.h p))
